rules.statement: When a property is sold under the Partition Ordinance, subsequent transactions should be registered in the original folio of registration to maintain priority over other registrations.
rules.supporting_quote: 'For certain purposes the question of identity may be as important in the one case as in the other. It is true that there is no express provision with regard to a sale of the land by decree, but I think that the language of section 24 of the Registration Ordinance is wide enough to include the case of a certificate of sale under the Partition Ordinance, for it enacts that ' when any property which shall have been once registered shall be subsequently sold, encumbered, or otherwise affected or dealt with, the deed or instrument purporting to transfer or otherwise deal with or affect such property shall state the volume and folio of the register in which such property has been previously registered.'
